message: You know that one friend who has a smoke alarm in every room and a fire escape plan mapped out like a treasure hunt? Yeah, that’s me. I used to think I was just gloriously over-prepared, but after a small kitchen mishap where the smoke alarm actually saved my dinner (and maybe my sanity), I realized there’s a method to my madness. Having a plan and the right tools at hand can really take the stress out of unexpected moments. How do you keep your home safe and sound?
